name: Otome
source:
One of the inhabitants of the town and the owner of "Snack Otome" in the shopping district, selling coffee during the day and snacks at night. He is a good-natured person among townspeople who are typically unhinged. Because the shop is an easy place to gather intel, he often knows many secrets of the people living in the world.

[spoiler] He is the biological father of Ao. [/spoiler]

[Source [URL=https://zombilica.com/games/nienomati_iromusubi/chara_08otome.html] official website profile.[/URL]]
